findings.text: Twelve selected crypto cases call real crypto libraries but test-local policy functions, not SDK production ticket validators.
Expired fixture concerns signing-key validity and a local reason code, not all credential expiry axes or production recoverability.
Replay fixture supplies jti_seen; no live replay store or first-accept/second-use state transition is exercised.
Rotation selected bodies check revocation refusal only, not new-credential acceptance or rotation operation.
Tampered-claim cases check signature rejection; every identity/domain mismatch is not covered by those bodies.
Missing-secret selected tests call direct resolvers in Python/TypeScript, client construction in Rust.
Directory unavailable selected fixtures use transport errors in Python/TypeScript, HTTP200 missing decision in Rust.

limits: 19 retained test/production/fixture files match accepted harness source bytes; this is not installed-package equivalence or runtime reproduction.
Original accepted outcomes are preserved. Selected-assertion gaps do not automatically establish a product defect or invalidate accepted evidence.
Supporting positive tests and unselected fixture vectors are source context, not new credited execution.
Current development sources, all normative clauses, independent interoperability and external certification are outside this analysis.
